api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Bearer token of the sports API. Write-only: it is masked when settings are read back.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Base URL of the sports API, without a trailing slash.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: League ids to track, in display order (epl, laliga, nba). Empty tracks all three.

group_emoji.title: Group emoji
group_emoji.description: Prefix the regrouped sport groups with an emoji (for example Football).
